sections.Profile:
"Breakshot," produced by Capcom in May 1996, offers a modern take on classic electromechanical (EM) pinball aesthetics combined with contemporary gameplay features. Designed by Greg Kmiec, this machine features a billiards theme with a straightforward playfield layout, avoiding ramps and opting for a more traditional single-level design.

- Years made: 1996
